_source: Shaped from GitHub's REST documentation as summarised by web search on 2026-11-08 (docs.github.com could not be fetched from the build session). UNVERIFIED against real GitHub until the founder's run after Phase 2 (F22 T3.0, T4.8, foundation item 28); T4.8 replaces these with sanitized real responses. Values are made up. Page: 'List repositories accessible to the app installation', GET /installation/repositories; one element of `repositories`. The response is {total_count, repository_selection, repositories}; `full_name` and `private` are from general knowledge of GitHub's repository object, not confirmed by the search.
